items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh injury (mid/late game vs Lions after red-zone carry).
items.why: Thigh injury on tackle; quickly ruled out.
items.implication: Immediate remove; rest-of-game and potential multi-week concern for handcuff elevation.
items.opportunity: Bulk remaining carries/snaps/goal-line to Jets RB2 (Allen/Davis committee).

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled out vs. Chiefs due to knee injury after being Q to return mid-game.
items.why: Knee injury sustained; confirmed out by Schefter/Rapoport.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; elevates MIA RB committee backups for remaining snaps/carries.
items.opportunity: Full remaining RB volume to handcuffs/backups in pass-heavy script vs KC.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active today vs. the Cowboys after pregame workout on hamstring that looked good; Rapoport notes likely limited usage.
items.why: Pregame workout successful; official active after true GTD.
items.implication: Start-worthy if rostered despite limit risk; reverse prior OUT projs/Bateman/Andrews upgrades.
items.opportunity: Primary WR role if not heavily limited; red-zone/routes potential vs DAL.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers is active and will make his 2026 season debut vs. Saints (knee).
items.why: Confirmed active by team/Schefter/Rapoport after Q listing and limited practices.
items.implication: Must-start TE1; full or near-full routes/targets expected in debut.
items.opportunity: High target share, red-zone, slot/wide usage as featured pass-catcher.

items.text: Berry on Flowers ACTIVE: Risky but if active for Ravens he's active for me; start over Bateman.
items.why: Active status overrides risk; prefers to Bateman.
items.implication: Start Flowers in flex/WR if available.

items.text: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren active (shoulder); expected per ETR/Levitan/Schefter/Pittman also expected/active (foot).
items.why: Confirmed in actives; Dowdle OUT context boosts Warren.
items.implication: Warren lead back volume; Pittman WR targets back.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/routes/targets/red-zone for Warren with Dowdle out; Pittman perimeter.

items.text: Mike Evans (hip) and Jalen Coker active; Xavier Legette OUT, Coker up for Panthers.
items.why: Confirmed actives; Legette out boosts Coker.
items.implication: Evans startable; Coker elevated WR opportunity.
items.opportunity: Evans routes/targets; Coker target share bump post-Legette OUT.

items.text: Jets WR Adonai Mitchell (finger) expected inactive vs Lions (was GTD); Levitan details depth: Wilson 1, Isaiah Williams 2, Pritchett, Shepard, McLain + TE Sadiq slot/wide.
items.implication: Wilson clear alpha; secondary WRs/Sadiq elevated targets/routes.
items.opportunity: Increased snap/route/target share for Wilson and depth WRs/TE in slot.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder) expected/active vs Chargers; ETR/Levitan projected in but limited.
items.why: Source expected to play; confirmed in actives with Coleman.
items.implication: Startable but monitor snap share/limit; Keon Coleman also up.
items.opportunity: WR snaps/targets in Bills offense if not heavily limited.

items.text: Levitan: Flowers (hamstring) OUT in ETR projs (late Bateman/Andrews DFS swap possible); projecting Warren/Evans/Bowers IN; Moore limited, Mitchell out (later confirmed).
items.why: Conservative proj pending clarity; high opp/DFS focus.
items.implication: Late-swap ready; confirmed IN for others drove confidence.
items.opportunity: If Flowers out: Bateman/Andrews; else full for expected INs.

items.text: ETR Sunday AM summary: Flowers GTD (not counting); Spears hopeful GTD; Expected: Warren/Pittman, Barkley/Smith, Bowers, Evans, Coker, Coleman. Q: Parkinson, Bagent. Levitan notes Flowers OUT in projs initially, Moore limited, Mitchell out.
items.why: Comprehensive weekend reports aggregation for projections.
items.implication: Base for late swaps; many Q resolved ACTIVE later.
items.opportunity: Monitor beneficiaries if any OUT (e.g. Flowers -> Bateman/Andrews).
items.conflict: Initial Flowers OUT proj flipped to ACTIVE.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins OUT second straight (hamstring); decent chance return Week 4 vs DAL.
items.opportunity: Schultz high TS continues; other HOU pass-catchers.

items.text: Berry loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5), DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 YPG.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak run D; high prop.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches, 15% target share both games, RB7 util (86); PIT allows 5th-most RB rush yards.
Berry loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 YPR to WRs.
items.why: Volume + deep threat vs soft secondary.

items.text: Berry loves Christian Watson vs ATL (WR8 util, 38% RZ share, WR9 PPG since W11 last yr) and Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% TS w/ Collins out; IND 4th-most TE yards).
items.why: Usage spikes and matchups; Schultz boosted by Collins OUT.
items.implication: Start Watson/Schultz; Collins OUT continues elevating TE.

items.text: Berry hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RB), Travis Etienne vs LV (49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even w/ Kamara), Terry McLaurin vs SEA (fewest WR FPs allowed, low team total).
items.implication: Sit/fade; Henderson gained 65% snaps post-Stevenson fumble but Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead.
items.opportunity: Henderson role expansion monitored; Etienne limited committee.
items.conflict: Henderson usage up vs Stevenson rank.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Henderson 65% snaps/out-touched Stevenson 16-5 post-fumble (gap narrowed but Stevenson still ranked ahead); Schultz 28% TS/30% routes w/ Collins out; London 20+ PPR/35% TS/97 yds avg w/ Penix (12 games).
items.implication: Monitor Henderson committee; Schultz TE1 upside w/ Collins out (W4 chance); London smash w/ Penix.
items.opportunity: Henderson snap/carry share; Schultz targets; London high TS/routes.
items.conflict: Berry ranks Stevenson > Henderson despite usage.
